title: KanSTL
summary: STL 3D viewer for the Cardputer Zero
description:
KanSTL opens STL 3D models on the Cardputer Zero and lets you look at them from every side.
Pick a file from the built-in browser, then rotate and zoom with the keypad. One key cycles four looks: solid, edges, metallic and wireframe, and auto-rotate turns the model slowly when you want to see it all round. A small XYZ gizmo keeps you oriented.

Models are read straight from the device: copy STL files over SSH or a USB stick, and the browser remembers the folder you were in. Binary and ASCII files both work.

No permissions, no network, no background service.Open source, GPL-3.0.
